# Vendored htm/preact

`standalone.module.js` is `preact/standalone.module.js` from the npm package `htm`, unchanged: Preact 10, its hooks and htm's tagged templates in one ES module.

Version: `htm@3.1.1`
Tarball: `https://registry.npmjs.org/htm/-/htm-3.1.1.tgz`
npm integrity: `sha512-983Vyg8NwUE7JkZ6NmOqpCZ+sh1bKv2iYTlUkzlWmA5JD2acKoxd4KVxbMmxX/85mtfdnDmTFoNKcg5DGAvxNQ==`
SHA-256: `72284e8e9079c87817145df1110f74e8a2aa040b2fc384922e18dfcb46fc1fd7`

A test in `tests/it/main.rs` checks the file against the SHA-256 above. To update, download the tarball of the new version, check its integrity against `npm view htm dist.integrity`, copy `package/preact/standalone.module.js` here and update the lines above.

htm is Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE`, copied from the package). The Preact code inside the file is MIT, Copyright (c) 2015-present Jason Miller.
